title: Accurate prediction of protein structures and interactions using a 3-track network
layout_note: Only panel A is the method (B and C are benchmark bar charts). Three horizontal light-grey bands are stacked top to bottom - 1D track, 2D track and, under the right half only, 3D track - each named by a boxed tag at its corner. Inputs (a coloured MSA plot, a pair-feature matrix with axes) enter the 1D and 2D bands at the left; data runs left to right along each band and vertically between them. At the right the outputs branch: up through a grey 'SE(3)-Transformers' box to a backbone-only model, and down from the combined pair map via 'Gradient-based folding' to a full-atom model.
grouping: Background bands group the states of each track. Two coloured outline rectangles mark the repeated units - a yellow one around a 2-track block (1D and 2D bands only) and a larger blue one around a 3-track block that also reaches down into the 3D band - keyed by a two-entry outline legend at the top right. Dashed arrows stand for the blocks that are skipped.
shapes_depth: Almost no boxes: every state is a small rendering of its data - viridis-coloured heatmap tiles for 1D features, dark square pair maps with a bright diagonal for 2D features, rainbow-coloured cartoon proteins (some on white tiles) for the 3D track and the outputs. Thin black arrows carry the operation names (Attention, Outer product & aggregation, Masked Attention, Graph-Transformer, SE(3)-Transformer). The only filled box is the grey SE(3)-Transformers box.
proposed_highlight: The paper's unit, the 3-track block, is the largest frame - a blue outline crossing all three bands - set against the smaller yellow 2-track block; operations stay as arrow labels.
lesson: Draw the 1D, 2D and 3D representations as three stacked horizontal bands in which every state is a thumbnail of its own data (feature tile, pair map, cartoon structure), and mark one repeated block by a coloured outline that spans exactly the bands it updates.
notes: Venue = bioRxiv preprint: the PDF header reads 'this version posted June 15, 2021' (v1; venue_source: pdf); no journal version was checked. Measured on a trimmed copy of panel A only (crops/rosettafold/fig1a.png = the top 505 px of fig1.png), because B and C are results. The figure is one embedded raster, so photo_share is null and the palette includes the viridis heatmaps and rainbow structure renders. Annotation note (2026-11-15): fetch-crop failed (card has no fetch recipe: no arXiv id or pdf_url); annotated from the cached crop kb-build/protein-structure/crops/rosettafold/fig1a.png (panel A only; panels B and C are benchmark bar charts).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: Three grey horizontal bands stacked top to bottom (1D track, 2D track, and a 3D track under the right half only), each named by a boxed corner tag, with a yellow outline around the 2-track block and a larger blue outline around the 3-track block spanning all three bands.
insights.data: Every state is a picture of its data: viridis heatmap tiles for 1D features, dark pair maps with a bright diagonal for 2D, rainbow cartoon proteins for 3D, and the inputs are a coloured MSA plot and a pair-feature matrix with axes.
insights.emphasis: The repeated 3-track block is the largest coloured frame and the only one crossing all three bands, keyed against the smaller yellow 2-track block by a two-entry outline legend at top right.
insights.flow: States move left to right along each band, operations (Attention, Outer product & aggregation, Graph-Transformer, SE(3)-Transformer) label vertical and diagonal arrows between bands, and dashed arrows stand for skipped repeated blocks before the outputs branch up to a BB-only model and down to a full-atom model.
insights.avoid: The diagonal arrow labels ('Outer product & aggregation', rotated 'Masked Attention') are rotated and crowd the tiles; small axis tick labels on the input plots are illegible at figure size.

arrangement.units: one grey tinted band per track (1D, 2D, 3D) with a boxed tag at its corner; repeated blocks are coloured outline rectangles overlaid across exactly the bands they update
arrangement.inputs_as: real data plots (MSA as a coloured matrix plot, pair features as a matrix with axes) entering the 1D and 2D bands
arrangement.shared: outputs at the right edge (SE(3)-Transformers box, combined pair map) take from both the 1D and 2D bands
